auditandcompliance.audittrace.desc: SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each audit-and-compliance record

auditandcompliance.profjoin.desc: INT referencing DataProfile(ProfileTrace). Ties this audit to a specific data profile

auditandcompliance.compjoin.desc: INT referencing Compliance(ComplianceTrace). Links the audit to a compliance record

auditandcompliance.vendjoin.desc: INT referencing VendorManagement(VendorTrace). Connects this record to a specific vendor

auditandcompliance.audtrailstate.desc: auditstatus_enum enumerating the audit trail status. Currently possible values: (Complete, Missing, Partial)

auditandcompliance.findtally.desc: SMALLINT storing the count of audit findings identified

auditandcompliance.critfindnum.population: critical audit findings of the record
auditandcompliance.critfindnum.desc: SMALLINT counting how many critical findings were discovered

auditandcompliance.remedstate.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing remediation status (e.g., 'Pending', 'In Progress'). Currently possible values: (In Progress, Not Started, Completed)

auditandcompliance.remeddue.desc: DATE specifying the deadline for remediation actions

auditandcompliance.authnotify.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing if/when authorities must be notified. Currently possible values: (Not Required, Required, Submitted)

auditandcompliance.bordermech.desc: VARCHAR(40) capturing cross-border mechanism (SCC, BCR, etc.) if relevant. Currently possible values: (SCCs, Adequacy Decision, Derogations, BCRs)

auditandcompliance.transimpassess.desc: TEXT describing any transfer impact assessment for cross-border data flows. Currently possible values: (Required, Completed, In Progress)

auditandcompliance.localreqs.desc: TEXT detailing local requirements or constraints on the data flow. Currently possible values: (Not Met, Met, Partial)

auditandcompliance.datamapstate.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing the data mapping status (complete, partial, etc.). Currently possible values: (Partial, Complete, Outdated)

auditandcompliance.sysintstate.desc: VARCHAR(40) referencing the system integration status. Currently possible values: (Fully Integrated, Manual, Partial)

auditandcompliance.accreqnum.desc: SMALLINT counting how many access requests have been received

auditandcompliance.delreqnum.desc: SMALLINT counting how many data deletion requests were filed

auditandcompliance.rectreqnum.desc: SMALLINT counting how many rectification (correction) requests were made

auditandcompliance.portreqnum.desc: SMALLINT counting how many data portability requests were received

auditandcompliance.resptimeday.desc: NUMERIC(4,1) capturing the average or allowed response time (days) to subject requests

compliance.compliancetrace.desc: SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each compliance record

compliance.risktie.desc: INT referencing RiskManagement(RiskTrace). Links compliance data to a specific risk record

compliance.vendortie.desc: INT referencing VendorManagement(VendorTrace). Connects compliance info to a specific vendor record

compliance.recordregistry.desc: CHAR(10) optionally referencing an older 'RecordID'. May be used for cross references

compliance.legalbase.desc: VARCHAR(150) describing the legal basis for data processing (e.g., 'Consent', 'Legal Obligation'). Currently possible values: (Legal Obligation, Contract, Legit

compliance.consentstate.desc: VARCHAR(30) capturing the status of consent (e.g., 'Obtained', 'Revoked'). Currently possible values: (Not Required, Valid, Expired, Pending)

compliance.consentcoll.desc: DATE indicating when user consent was collected

compliance.consentexp.desc: DATE indicating when that consent expires or needs renewal

compliance.purplimit.desc: VARCHAR(300) specifying the purpose limitation or constraints (GDPR principle). Currently possible values: (General, Multiple, Specific)

compliance.purpdesc.desc: TEXT describing the purpose for data processing in detail. Currently possible values: (Business Operations, Research, Marketing, Compliance)

compliance.gdprcomp.desc: compliancelevel_enum enumerating GDPR compliance level. Currently possible values: (Partial, Non-compliant, Compliant)

compliance.ccpacomp.desc: compliancelevel_enum enumerating CCPA compliance level. Currently possible values: (Compliant, Non-compliant, Partial)

compliance.piplcomp.desc: compliancelevel_enum enumerating PIPL compliance level. Currently possible values: (Non-compliant, Partial, Compliant)

compliance.loclawcomp.desc: compliancelevel_enum enumerating local law compliance. Currently possible values: (Non-compliant, Compliant, Partial)

compliance.regapprovals.desc: VARCHAR(300) listing any regulatory approvals or licenses obtained. Currently possible values: (Obtained, Not Required, Pending)

compliance.privimpassess.desc: TEXT capturing the privacy impact assessment details or outcome. Currently possible values: (Completed, In Progress, Required)

compliance.datasubjright.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing data subject rights or status (access, erasure, portability, etc.). Currently possible values: (Partial, Fully Supported, Limited)

dataflow.recordregistry.desc: CHAR(10) primary key uniquely identifying each data flow record in the DataFlow table

dataflow.flowstamp.desc: TIMESTAMP(6) for the moment this data flow record was created or logged. Microsecond precision

dataflow.flowtag.desc: A short identifier or tag (VARCHAR(20)) for the data flow, previously 'DataFlowID'

dataflow.orignation.desc: VARCHAR(80) storing the source/origin country's name for this data flow

dataflow.destnation.desc: VARCHAR(80) storing the destination country's name for this data flow

dataflow.origactor.desc: VARCHAR(150) referencing the source entity/system initiating the flow (person, organization, or app)

dataflow.destactor.desc: VARCHAR(150) referencing the destination entity/system receiving the flow

dataflow.chanproto.desc: VARCHAR(30) for the protocol used (HTTP, FTP, SFTP, etc.). Currently possible values: (Blockchain, SFTP, Private Network, HTTPS)

dataflow.chanfreq.desc: VARCHAR(25) specifying how frequently data is transferred (daily, weekly, on-demand, etc.). Currently possible values: (Weekly, Hourly, Real-time, Daily)

dataflow.datasizemb.desc: NUMERIC(12,2) representing the size in MB of each data transfer

dataflow.durmin.desc: SMALLINT capturing the average or actual duration (in minutes) of the data flow

dataflow.bwidthpct.desc: NUMERIC(5,2) for bandwidth utilization percentage (0 to 100%)

dataflow.successpct.desc: NUMERIC(5,2) measuring the success rate (0–100%) of the flow attempts

dataflow.errtally.desc: SMALLINT counting the total errors or failures observed for this data flow

dataflow.rtrytally.desc: SMALLINT storing how many retry attempts were made after failures

dataprofile.profiletrace.desc: SERIAL primary key identifying each data profile record

dataprofile.flowsign.desc: CHAR(10) referencing DataFlow(RecordRegistry), linking this profile to a particular data flow

dataprofile.riskjoin.desc: INT referencing RiskManagement(RiskTrace). Associates the data profile with a relevant risk record

dataprofile.datatype.desc: VARCHAR(80) describing the category of data (financial, personal, logs, etc.). Currently possible values: (Commercial, Personal, Financial, Industrial, Medical)

dataprofile.datasense.desc: VARCHAR(30) designating data sensitivity level (High, Medium, Low). Currently possible values: (High, Low, Critical, Medium)

dataprofile.volgb.desc: NUMERIC(10,2) representing the approximate data volume in gigabytes

dataprofile.rectally.desc: BIGINT counting how many records exist in this data set or flow

dataprofile.subjtally.desc: BIGINT enumerating how many unique data subjects are impacted/contained

dataprofile.retdays.desc: INT storing the retention duration (in days) for this data

dataprofile.formattype.desc: VARCHAR(80) naming the data format (CSV, JSON, XML, proprietary, etc.). Currently possible values: (Mixed, Unstructured, Structured)

dataprofile.qltyscore.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) capturing data quality on a custom 0–100 scale

dataprofile.intcheck.desc: checkstatus_enum enumerating data integrity check status. Currently possible values: (Passed, Failed, Partial)

dataprofile.csumverify.desc: checkstatus_enum enumerating checksum verification status. Currently possible values: (Failed, Success, Pending)

dataprofile.srcvalstate.desc: checkstatus_enum enumerating source validation status. Currently possible values: (Pending, Verified, Failed)

dataprofile.destvalstate.desc: checkstatus_enum enumerating destination validation status. Currently possible values: (Pending, Verified, Failed)

riskmanagement.risktrace.desc: SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each risk management record

riskmanagement.flowlink.desc: CHAR(10) referencing DataFlow(RecordRegistry), linking this risk record to a specific data flow

riskmanagement.recordregistry.desc: CHAR(10) formerly 'RecordID'; can be used for cross-references or historical reasons

riskmanagement.riskassess.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) storing the assessed risk score (0–100 or custom)

riskmanagement.riskmitstate.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing how the risk is being mitigated. Currently possible values: (Pending, Partial, Implemented)

riskmanagement.secureaction.desc: TEXT describing security measures or controls used to reduce identified risks. Currently possible values: (Adequate, Strong, Insufficient)

riskmanagement.breachnotify.desc: TEXT outlining the procedure for breach notification if a security event occurs. Currently possible values: (Partial, Established, Missing)

riskmanagement.incidentplan.desc: TEXT capturing the incident response plan or steps for handling security/operational events. Currently possible values: (Missing, Active, Outdated)

riskmanagement.incidentcount.desc: SMALLINT counting incidents recorded for this data flow or scenario

riskmanagement.nearmissnum.desc: SMALLINT enumerating near misses (close calls that didn't escalate)

riskmanagement.avgresolhrs.desc: NUMERIC(5,2) average incident resolution time in hours

riskmanagement.slapct.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) indicating SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance percentage (0–100%)

riskmanagement.costusd.desc: NUMERIC(11,2) capturing the cost of compliance in USD (security, risk measures, etc.)

riskmanagement.penusd.desc: NUMERIC(11,2) storing potential or actual penalty/fine risk in USD

riskmanagement.coveragestate.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing insurance coverage status (e.g., 'Full', 'Partial', 'None'). Currently possible values for discovered data: (Limited, Adequate)

riskmanagement.residrisklevel.desc: VARCHAR(40) naming the residual risk level after mitigation (Low, Medium, High, etc.). Currently possible values: (Medium, High, Low)

riskmanagement.ctrleff.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) rating the effectiveness of current controls (0–100)

riskmanagement.compscore.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) measuring overall compliance posture (0–100 or custom)

riskmanagement.maturitylevel.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing the maturity of processes (Initial, Managed, Optimized, etc.). Currently possible values: (Optimized, Managed, Initial)

riskmanagement.nextrevdate.desc: DATE specifying when the next risk/compliance review is scheduled

riskmanagement.planstate.desc: VARCHAR(45) capturing improvement or remediation plan status (e.g., 'Planned', 'Completed'). Currently possible values: (On Track, Not Started, Delayed)

securityprofile.securitytrace.desc: SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each security profile record

securityprofile.flowkey.desc: CHAR(10) referencing DataFlow(RecordRegistry). Associates security details with a data flow

securityprofile.riskkey.desc: INT referencing RiskManagement(RiskTrace). Links security measures to a risk record

securityprofile.profilekey.desc: INT referencing DataProfile(ProfileTrace). Ties security info to a data profile

securityprofile.encmeth.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing the encryption method used (AES, RSA, etc.). Currently possible values: (SM4, Custom, RSA-2048, AES-256)

securityprofile.keymanstate.desc: VARCHAR(40) for key management status. Currently possible values: (Hybrid, Distributed, Centralized)

securityprofile.masklevel.desc: partialnone_enum enumerating data masking. Currently possible values: (Partial, Full)

securityprofile.anonmeth.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing the anonymization methodology. Currently possible values: (T-Closeness, K-Anonymity, L-Diversity)

securityprofile.psymstate.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing pseudonymization status. Currently possible values: (Partial, Applied)

securityprofile.authmeth.desc: VARCHAR(40) specifying the authentication method (Basic, OAuth, SAML, etc.). Currently possible values: (Basic, SSO, MFA)

securityprofile.authzframe.desc: VARCHAR(45) specifying the authorization framework (RBAC, ABAC, etc.). Currently possible values: (ABAC, Custom, RBAC)

securityprofile.aclstate.desc: VARCHAR(30) describing the current access control status. Currently possible values: (Adequate, Strong, Weak)

securityprofile.apisecstate.desc: VARCHAR(30) enumerating the API security posture. Currently possible values: (Vulnerable, Secure, Review Required)

securityprofile.logintcheck.desc: VARCHAR(30) specifying the log integrity check mechanism. Currently possible values: (Pending, Passed, Failed)

securityprofile.logretdays.desc: SMALLINT indicating how many days audit logs are retained

securityprofile.bkpstate.desc: VARCHAR(35) describing the backup status. Currently possible values: (Current, Failed, Outdated)

securityprofile.drecstate.desc: VARCHAR(35) describing the disaster recovery status. Currently possible values: (Untested, Tested, Missing)

securityprofile.bcstate.desc: VARCHAR(35) storing the business continuity status or plan stage. Currently possible values: (Active, Outdated, Review Required)

vendormanagement.vendortrace.desc: SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each vendor management record

vendormanagement.secjoin.desc: INT referencing SecurityProfile(SecurityTrace). Ties vendor data with a security profile

vendormanagement.riskassoc.desc: INT referencing RiskManagement(RiskTrace). Connects vendor data to risk management info

vendormanagement.recordregistry.desc: CHAR(10) an optional cross-ref field, historically 'RecordID'

vendormanagement.vendassess.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing vendor assessment status. Currently possible values: (Completed, In Progress, Due)

vendormanagement.vendsecrate.desc: securityrating_enum enumerating vendor security rating. Currently possible values: (A, B, C, D)

vendormanagement.vendauddate.desc: DATE indicating when the vendor was last audited

vendormanagement.contrstate.desc: VARCHAR(30) capturing the contract state. Currently possible values: (Active, Under Review, Expired)

vendormanagement.contrexpire.desc: DATE specifying when the current contract expires

vendormanagement.dpastate.desc: VARCHAR(30) referencing Data Processing Agreement status. Currently possible values: (Required, Signed, Pending)

vendormanagement.sccstate.desc: VARCHAR(30) referencing Standard Contractual Clauses status. Currently possible values: (Implemented, Partial, Not Required)

vendormanagement.bcrstate.desc: VARCHAR(30) capturing the status of Binding Corporate Rules. Currently possible values: (Approved, Pending, Not Applicable)

vendormanagement.docustate.desc: VARCHAR(30) describing the vendor’s documentation completeness. Currently possible values: (Complete, Incomplete, Partial)

vendormanagement.polcomp.desc: VARCHAR(30) enumerating vendor’s policy compliance. Currently possible values: (Partial, Full, Non-compliant)

vendormanagement.proccomp.desc: VARCHAR(30) enumerating vendor’s procedure compliance status. Currently possible values: (Non-compliant, Full, Partial)

vendormanagement.trainstate.desc: VARCHAR(30) referencing the training status of vendor employees. Currently possible values: (Due, Overdue, Current)

vendormanagement.certstate.desc: VARCHAR(30) referencing certifications the vendor holds. Currently possible values: (Pending, Expired, Valid)

vendormanagement.monstate.desc: VARCHAR(30) storing the vendor’s monitoring status or approach. Currently possible values: (Inactive, Partial, Active)

vendormanagement.repstate.desc: VARCHAR(30) capturing the vendor’s reporting requirements or status. Currently possible values: (Delayed, Current, Overdue)

vendormanagement.stakecomm.desc: TEXT detailing stakeholder communication or engagement strategy for the vendor relationship. Currently possible values: (Limited, Poor, Regular)
